map.χ² 大表示观察与期望偏离大，越可能拒绝原假设（独立/拟合）。: A large χ² means the observed deviates a lot from expected, making it more likely you reject the null hypothesis (independence / fit).
map.χ² 越大说明什么？: What does a larger χ² mean?
map.→ 打开卡方检验计算器工具: -> Open the chi-square test calculator tool
map.列联表独立性检验、分布拟合检验。: Contingency table independence test and distribution fitting test.
map.卡方检验计算器：输入观测值与期望值频数，计算 χ² 统计量并判断分布偏离显著性，: Chi-square test calculator: enter observed and expected frequencies to compute the χ² statistic and judge the significance of the distribution deviation, for goodness of fit and independence tests.
map.比较观察频数与期望频数：χ²=Σ(O−E)²/E。: Compare observed with expected frequencies: χ²=Σ(O−E)²/E.
map.独立性检验 E_ij=行和_i×列和_j/总计；拟合检验按理论比例分配。任一期望: Independence test E_ij = row sum_i × column sum_j / total; the fit test allocates by theoretical proportions. Any expected count below 5 should be merged or use a correction.
map.由均值与标准差求变异系数: Coefficient of variation from mean and standard deviation
map.自由度=(行−1)(列−1) 查临界值。: Degrees of freedom = (rows−1)(cols−1) for looking up the critical value.
map.：抛硬币 100 次期望 50/50，观察 60/40：χ²=(10²+10²): : 100 coin flips expect 50/50; observing 60/40 gives χ²=(10²+10²)/50=4, df=1, p≈0.045, significant at the critical level.
map.：观察 O=[60,40;30,70]（行列和均 100），期望 E=50 各格: : observed O=[60,40;30,70] (all row and column sums 100), expected E=50 per cell: χ²=(10²+10²+20²+20²)/50=(100+100+400+400)/50=1000/50=20. With df=1 this far exceeds the critical 3.84, so the association is significant.
